description: Convert office documents and images between formats. Documents (docx, doc, xlsx, xls, pptx, ppt, odt, rtf, html, txt, csv) to pdf, docx, odt, txt, xlsx or csv; images between png, jpg, webp and gif. Use when a user or system needs a file in a different format. Send {url} or {base64}, plus filename (with extension) and to. Returns the converted file. Errors: 400 unsupported pair, 422 conversion failed. Price: $0.02 USDC per call (x402).

base64.description: File contents, base64-encoded (max 20 MB). Provide url OR base64.

filename.description: Original filename with extension, e.g. report.docx

to.description: Target format, e.g. pdf, docx, txt, png, webp

url.description: Public URL of the file. Provide url OR base64.

name: convert_file
title: Document and image file conversion
